summary: Build practical public investment appraisal, prioritisation, and portfolio monitoring skills. Explore the course and strengthen capital decisions.
lede: Public investment management training helps planning, budgeting and appraisal professionals assess and prioritise public capital projects. It covers project concept development, cost-benefit and options analysis, affordability testing, and portfolio selection against policy priorities and fiscal limits. Participants also practise reviewing appraisal evidence and tracking portfolio costs, schedules, risks and benefits through monitoring dashboards.
audienceIntro: Public investment management is designed for professionals who shape, assess, fund, govern, or monitor public capital programmes across ministries, agencies, local administrations, infrastructure authorities, and development-funded portfolios.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of public budgeting, project concepts, or programme planning is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Basic spreadsheet confidence helps with NPV, sensitivity analysis, affordability profiles, and dashboard exercises. Advanced digital analytics and AI-assisted portfolio review are taught at the operational application level, not the technical engineering level.
